summary: Verified native Writer paragraph solid fill and uniform transparency through application, display, history, and persistence.
findings: Paragraph formatting exchanges pooled fill items independently and retains per-paragraph color when changing mixed transparency.
Chromium verified visible 51 percent transparency, undo, redo and reopen through the ordinary Writer command.
residual_risks: Gradient and image fills are outside the current paragraph slice. Global Calc JSDoc and file-size baseline issues are recorded in Findings.
